stage: pre-GPU analysis plan, exploratory TTFT only
prerequisite: formal post-run acceptance and independent post-run review with supervisor completed/0, evidence hashes checked before decoding timing results
cohort: three known DEV images, 4 budgets; 12 warmups and 36 measured, 3 repeats per image-budget; no new labels
endpoint: (first_token_selected_ns - t0_before_image_read_ns)/1e6; completion timestamp contains raw journal fsync and is not clean end-to-end latency
report: keep 36 raw measured jobs plus 12 warmups; per image and budget report n=3 and median/min/max; within same image and replicate report TTFT ratio K128,K512,K1024 / K256 and median paired ratio per image. No cross-image confidence intervals or population-speed conclusions from n=3 known anchors.
retention: retain all samples including health overlaps or unusual durations; show every direct supervisor health overlap and list all windows; external background and residual health overhead are not measured and cannot be assigned per sample
comparison: K1024 is keep-all with zero greedy, not K1024 greedy; adapter hooks have overhead for every budget; prior Pixel/EADP pilot not paired or merged
memory: no process or device peak memory claims; separate isolated NVML measurement required
